comparison.objective: Candidate removes and contains HELICOIL tangs; record rolls maki with a bamboo mat and leaves it seam-side down.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires micro-alignment, hammer impact control, and fragment pickup; record requires coordinated mat wrapping, compliant-food shaping, seam orientation, and mat opening.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four clean fractures, retained inserts, and four contained tangs; record requires a completed seam-down roll, opened flat mat, and release. No specs add thresholds.
comparison.reason: Compliant wrapping and shaping are materially different from rigid contact-driven fracture and metal-fragment recovery.
